meta.title: About XePrime
meta.description: XePrime is the marketplace connecting vehicle owners and renters across Vietnam: self-drive, with driver and long-term rentals, with prices and responsibilities stated before you book.

hero.title: Renting a vehicle without the guesswork
hero.lead: XePrime connects people who need a vehicle with the people who own one, across Vietnam. We do not own a single vehicle — our job is to make the price, the calendar and each side's responsibilities clear before anyone pays.

selfDrive.title: Self-drive
selfDrive.desc: You drive. Collect at the shop or ask for delivery, priced by the hour or by the day.

withDriver.title: With driver
withDriver.desc: Intercity trips, airport runs or half-day hire — the shop assigns the driver and the route is agreed up front.

longTerm.title: Long-term
longTerm.desc: Fixed packages from 1 to 12 months for regular travel, with the return date counted in calendar months.

how.heading: How a rental works
how.lead: Four steps, and none of them takes your money before the owner agrees.

request.title: Send a request
request.desc: Pick the vehicle, the time window and where you want it. This step charges nothing and holds nothing.

accept.title: The shop accepts
accept.desc: The owner reviews your request. Only now is the calendar held, the price fixed, and the exact amount to transfer shown to you.

hold.title: Transfer the holding amount
hold.desc: You pay within the payment window. The booking is created only once reconciliation confirms the money arrived in full.

trip.title: Pick up and return
trip.desc: Both sides sign a handover record with condition photos; the rest of the rental is paid directly to the owner at pick-up.

money.heading: Where the money goes
money.lead: Every amount has an owner, and we show each line instead of rolling them into one number.

hold.title: Paid online
hold.desc: The holding amount, the service fee and insurance where it applies. This is not the security deposit taken at pick-up.

pickup.title: Paid at pick-up
pickup.desc: The rest of the rental goes directly to the owner when you collect the vehicle — XePrime does not collect it on their behalf.

lines.title: Nothing bundled
lines.desc: Service fee, tax and insurance are three separate lines, frozen into the booking when it is created and never recalculated afterwards.

owners.heading: If you own a vehicle
owners.lead: Two ways to join the same marketplace — pick by scale, switch later.

basic.title: Individual owner
basic.desc: A few vehicles, no subscription. You only pay a service fee on trips that actually happen.

shop.title: Shop
shop.desc: A larger fleet on a plan priced by vehicle count and term. No XePrime percentage per trip, with the full management toolset.

listing.title: Vehicles are reviewed before listing
listing.desc: Vehicle records and documents go through platform review before any renter sees them.

calendar.title: No double bookings
calendar.desc: One vehicle cannot be booked twice for the same window — the rule lives in the database, not in a screen.

metrics.title: Reputation measured from behaviour
metrics.desc: A shop's response rate, response time and kept-trip rate come from the last 90 days of real data, not from self-reporting.

status.title: XePrime is still being finished
status.body: The product is not open to real users yet. The legal documents are drafts, and the operating entity will be published before we open properly.
